functional_requirements: L-bracket meant to join a vertical surface to a horizontal surface at 90 degrees.
M4 clearance holes (Ø4.5 mm) for M4 fasteners — one through the vertical leg, one through the horizontal base.
Base thickness 10 mm and leg thickness 10 mm provide rigid, load-bearing sections.
Non-geometric assumption: request did not specify material or process; defaulted to 3D-printed PLA for a general-purpose bracket.

Assumption: the '10 mm tall' overall figure in the request is reconciled with the stated 10 mm base and 10 mm leg thicknesses as a coherent L-profile of total height 40 mm (base 10 + leg-above-base 30).
special_features: The whole part MUST be symmetric about the vertical plane at Y = SYMMETRY_PLANE_Y (Y = BASE_WIDTH_Y/2 = 10): every feature's Y extent mirrors about that plane.
The vertical leg MUST occupy X = LEG_X_START to X = LEG_X_END (X = 30 to 40) and MUST NOT be placed at the X=0 end.
The vertical leg MUST be a plate of thickness LEG_THICKNESS_X (10) in X, rising in +Z from the base top face (Z = BASE_THICKNESS_Z) up to Z = OVERALL_Z.
The horizontal base MUST be a plate of thickness BASE_THICKNESS_Z (10) in Z spanning X = 0 to BASE_LENGTH_X and Y = 0 to BASE_WIDTH_Y, with its bottom face at Z = 0.
The leg base hole MUST penetrate the vertical leg along the X axis (through the 10 mm LEG_THICKNESS_X), NOT along Y or Z.
The base hole MUST penetrate the horizontal base along the Z axis (through the 10 mm BASE_THICKNESS_Z), NOT along X or Y.
Both holes MUST be M4 clearance holes of diameter CLEARANCE_HOLE_DIA_M4 (4.5 mm) — clearance, NOT tapped/threaded.
The base hole center MUST be located at (BASE_HOLE_X, BASE_HOLE_Y) = (10, 10), i.e. 10 mm from the base free edge (X=0) and centered 10 mm from each side edge (Y=0 and Y=20).
The leg hole center MUST be located at (Y, Z) = (LEG_HOLE_Y, LEG_HOLE_Z) = (10, 30), i.e. centered 10 mm from each side edge (Y=0 and Y=20) and 10 mm below the leg top edge (Z=OVERALL_Z).
The vertical leg and horizontal base MUST overlap/fuse into one connected solid at the X=30..40 corner; the leg MUST NOT float separately from the base.
